The '''ANS-5c sensor unit''' sometimes spelled '''ANs-5c''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite that was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and could be found on the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] and other [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]].<ref name="Z95">{{DB|starship|z95headhunter|Z-95 Headhunter}}</ref> Its "lock track" targeting system allowed the locking and tracking of targets, and calculate the correct firing angle. This obsoleted the need in older models to target "by eye".<ref name="TSC" />

The suites were equipped with [[PA-9r long-range phased tachyon detection array/Legends|PA-9r long range phased tachyon detection arrays]] and [[PG-7u short-range primary threat analysis grid/Legends|PG-7u short range primary threat analysis grids]].<ref name="TSC" />
